thread:
noah: quick spike in billing drift: SA owners getting billed when proxy-issued tokens are used. reproducer: 
``
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sa-delegated-token
X-Proxy-Id: proxy-d
X-Proxy-Origin: proj-proxy-D
```
anya: is proxy doing token exchange or pass-through?
teja: proxy-d is pass-through for perf. backend auth reads token.owner_project so attribution = SA project.
noah: that breaks product expectations. options: require exchange, accept signed origin header, or map proxy identity->tenant.
antea: (note: typo)
anya: small proposal: pilot HMAC-signed origin header from proxies. header names: `X-Redwood-Origin` and `X-Redwood-Origin-Sig`. Sig includes ts+nonce. Verify in auth, populate origin_source=proxy_signed when valid.
teja: implement nonce cache TTL 120s, emit metrics auth.origin.signed.accept and auth.origin.signed.reject, and auth.origin.replay.
consoleux: we'll add a "Attribution drift" widget: per-proxy drift %, top offending routes, and timeline. Also add a per-proxy toggle to accept signed origins.
noah: rollout plan: canary in staging to proxy-d only, monitor for 48h, then expand to proxy fleet. rollback if rejected>0.3% or latency p95 up >12ms.
ops-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@proxy-origin-sig -> canary staging.
teja: I'll open PRs for auth + proxy changes and include tests for sig verification and nonce replay.
anya: thanks. this should make quota/billing attribution reflect the requester's tenant rather than SA owners. :rocket:
